text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: New customer Helio hitting intermittent 429s while running onboarding smoke that does 12 parallel SDK session creates. They say it spikes ~500-900ms after session create.
omar_support: can you paste the SDK log snippet they sent?
maria_cs: pasted sanitized logs from Helio: 
```
INFO session.create -> 200
DEBUG emit-header x-helio-meta: v=2;env=staging;session=hi123
WARN POST /v1/complete -> 429 rate_limit
```
anya_engineer: that pattern matches a hot-shard from header-based hashing. are we including x-helio-meta in the LB hash key anywhere?
kai_infra: we did a config sweep last month that added some headers for affinity on a subset of edge pools. possible drift added helio-meta.
omar_support: Helio's test runs 12 inits concurrently with very similar session meta values.
anya_engineer: short term: two options: 1) infra deploy a tenant-scoped rule to drop x-helio-meta from hash key for helio tenant during onboarding; 2) SDK patch to remove the header from blocking init and send it async with jitter. Both combined is fastest.
kai_infra: I can open a small-scoped rule limited to x-tenant-id: helio-77 and auto-expire in 36h. Canary to 5% of tenant traffic first. PR queued -> PR-7207.
omar_support: Helio prefers infra workaround so they can continue the smoke. They agreed to throttle to 6 parallel for the next 30 minutes.
anya_engineer: I'll prepare a tiny SDK fix (0.4.1) that skips sending the helio-meta header during createSession and emits it asynchronously. ETA ~90m.
kai_infra: deploying canary now. deploy-bot: PR-7207 canary deploy started (canary=5%).
omar_support: booking 20m call with Helio in 15m to confirm acceptance of canary and get live traces.
anya_engineer: also adding a soft-smooth server-side change: on suspected init spikes, increase per-tenant queue buffering before hard 429 for 60s. Low-risk and will only run for traffic windows flagged by a score.
maria_cs: action items recap:
- kai_infra: canary edge rule PR-7207 (5% -> 100%) scoped to x-tenant-id: helio-77, auto-expire 36h
- anya_engineer: SDK patch 0.4.1 to background helio-meta header
- omar_support: coordinate Helio throttle and paste call logs here
- deploy-bot: monitor canary metrics and alert on any cross-tenant effects
deploy-bot: canary metrics streaming; no immediate error budget increase observed for the canary slice.
maria_cs: thanks team 8578 will update with Helio call notes and any failing request IDs.
